name: Skin Aqua Super Moisture

lead: Skin Aqua Super Moisture is a lightweight sunscreen essence from the Japanese company Rohto. It carries an SPF50+ PA++++ rating and a moisturizing formula that aims to leave skin hydrated rather than dry or tight.
People use it daily on face and body as sun protection that doubles as a makeup base, supporting a smoother, more even-looking complexion over time.

paras: It is applied as the last skincare step before makeup, in a thin essence-gel texture. Retailers list variants including Gold, Light Up and Barrier, and one listed version is fragrance-free and aimed at drier skin.
Chemical sunscreens can irritate sensitive skin in some users. Listings for the line are inconsistent between versions, so ingredients differ.

web.title: Rohto Skin Aqua Super Moisture Essence 80g - Sundrug

chain: Less UV exposure and drier skin
Smoother, more even-looking skin over time
angle.text: Daily broad sun protection limits UV exposure, which is associated with pigmentation and wrinkles, while the moisturizing base gives a comfortable finish under makeup.

lead: Skin Aqua Super Moisture is a sunscreen in Rohto's Skin Aqua line, sold in Japan and by importers abroad as an essence rated SPF50+ and PA++++. Rohto's Japanese listing describes it as an essence type with sodium hyaluronate and hyaluronic acid to hold moisture in the skin [1].

Its appeal in skincare circles is that it offers high UV protection with a light, hydrating feel, usable under makeup. Rohto describes micro-capsule technology that increases UV protection without penetrating skin [1]. Related versions include a brightening Light Up essence and a Gold version for dry skin [1].

paras: Listings show the essence in 70 and 80 g sizes, a Gold version described as lightweight, fragrance-free and moisturizing for drier skin, a UV Light Up essence marketed as brightening, a Barrier UV essence and a gel [1].
No studies found. Published trials of this specific product were not located.
